resource_and_operand_lifetime_observatio.operand_register_names: Baseline MMA sources reuse R60/R64 for P1 then P3 and R68/R72 for P2 then P4; cp.async MMA operand register sets extend separately through R114. This is static register-allocation evidence, not a dynamic liveness or occupancy measurement.
resource_and_operand_lifetime_observatio.compiled_pipeline_wait_caution: Both dtype functions wait for next raw bank at 0x1d60 after only three HMMAs, leaving eleven remaining. Higher registers, larger shared reservation, raw LDS overhead and cache changes are simultaneous differences; timing causality is unmeasured.
resource_and_operand_lifetime_observatio.barrier_caution: Source uses full-warp __syncwarp publication/reuse barriers, but selected one-warp convergent SASS has no explicit BAR.WARP.SYNC opcode. Absence alone does not establish a synchronization defect; source bank separation, generated completion waits, backedge order and sanitizers are the supporting evidence.

source_pipeline.prologue: Issue all eight original-quadrant 16-byte vectors per lane into bank0; commit; wait_all; compiler memory clobber; full-warp publish barrier.
source_pipeline.steady_stage: Conditionally issue next K16 original quadrant bits to opposite bank, then read current raw bank, compute unchanged FP32 S/T DAG, final pair RN casts, publish transformed operands, accumulate seven P in ascending order, wait/publish, flip.
source_pipeline.raw_bank_lifetime: Next writes are disjoint from current reads; a bank is reused only after its previous consumers and stage-end publication have completed. Transformed operands occupy a separate fixed buffer.
source_pipeline.numeric_order: Unchanged M1: full-K FP32 P1..P7 accumulation; same final U DAG; alpha __fmul_rn then beta fmaf once per output. Original input copies do not quantize again.
source_pipeline.alias_and_beta0: C0 and D have no restrict alias promise. Each owner uniquely writes its four output quadrants and loads those active-beta C0 values before stores. beta0 bypasses all C0 loads, permitting null C0.
source_pipeline.public_guard: Variant17 delegates generic packed7 contract: positive even <=32768 dimensions, row-major FP16/BF16, finite coefficients, valid leading dimensions and int64 address-range bounds. Specialized full path additionally requires all parent dimensions multiples of32, lda/ldb multiples8 and 16-byte aligned A/B. D and active C0 require float alignment. Full tiles launch grid(n/32,m/32) and each launch rechecks pointers; other valid calls fall back to packed7, with public dispatch choosing Dense for incompatible bindings.
source_pipeline.run_setup: Full path uses static shared, no runtime allocation or host synchronization. prepare delegates packed7; run launches on supplied stream.

CPU_address_and_bank_model.scope: CPU enumeration of formulas extracted from source; not GPU execution
CPU_address_and_bank_model.global_bound_reason: Full guard makes each half dimension a multiple16. Max lane row/K index15 and vector span0..15 stay inside each16x16 owner/quadrant; next_k<kh prevents a speculative copy after the last stage. lda/ldb%8 and aligned bases keep each16-byte vector aligned, including quadrant offsets and ld+8 padding. Stride products use int64 and inherit generic overflow bounds.

compiled_async_schedule.input_copy_sites_description: 8 prologue +8 conditional lookahead; dynamic total is8 times actual K16 stages, not16 per stage.
compiled_async_schedule.prologue_completion_wait: 0x0780 DEPBAR.LE SB0,0; before any current raw LDS.
compiled_async_schedule.guard: UR7:UR6 is incremented64-bit next_k; R116:R117 is kh. 0x1020/0x1040 combine next_k>=kh into P0; @!P0 BRA0x1060→0x0e10 enters lookahead copies only while next_k<kh. Otherwise falls through to current consumption.
compiled_async_schedule.bank_addresses: next R61=R118+R141*0x1000 with R141=currentxor1; current raw base R88=R118+current*0x1000. Raw slot offsets0..0xe00; transformed slots start+0x2000.
compiled_async_schedule.steady_wait: 0x1cc0 LDGDEPBAR then 0x1d60 DEPBAR.LE SB0,0. All14 LDSM are before wait, only first3 HMMA are before wait; remaining11 HMMA execute after.
compiled_async_schedule.backedge: @!P1 BRA0x1e70→0x0ff0 occurs after all14 HMMA and completion wait; final-stage fallthrough begins final U.
compiled_async_schedule.CuTe_local_helper: SM80_CP_ASYNC_CACHEALWAYS<uint4> emits cp.async.ca.shared.global.L2::128B16B; cp_async_fence emits commit_group; cp_async_wait<0> emits wait_all. Extra LDGDEPBAR sites coexist with wait_all lowering; do not count each as a separately populated data group. Source wrappers add compiler memory clobbers around commit and after wait, then full-warp sync.
compiled_async_schedule.last_read_proof_limit: Static LDGSTS count alone cannot prove the absence of a last-stage extra read. The guarded compiled branch, frozen source, CPU enumeration and actual short-K sanitizer paths jointly support that claim; full-K exhaustive GPU validation was not performed.
